Radiology Report
Date: 08/20/2026
Patient: Cecil Jacobs, 84-year-old male

Examination: MRI Lumbar Spine

Findings:
MRI lumbar spine 08/20/2026: L3-L4 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.

Impression:
There is a herniated disc at the L3-L4 level causing moderate narrowing of the left neural foramen and impinging on the exiting nerve root. No other significant abnormalities are noted in the lumbar spine.

Recommendations:
Clinical correlation is advised to assess symptoms related to the L3-L4 nerve root involvement. Further management should be guided by the referring physician.
